messages:
Dana V: Tiny recurring problem: some partners calls hit strict fncall validator and route to degen. low volume but noisy.
Oleg M: saw it. Example (sanitized):
```json
{"session":"s_x","tool_output":[{"text":"ok"}]}
```
Oleg M: validator expects {"tool_output":{"items":[...]}} so array -> hard reject.
Priya S: Ops: can we auto-coerce array->items for small diffs as a canary for 24h? Need telemetry split + billing tag.
metrics-bot: Alert: fncall_validation_reject_rate > 1% (region=us-west) https://console/redwood/alerts/555
Ken R: Short plan: 1) enable auto-coerce for flagged orgs for 24h (per-org flag); 2) emit trace tags validation_action=auto_coerce|reject and validation_confidence=high|med|low; 3) deterministic sampling 10% for failing orgs to capture model_decodes; 4) tag fallback_route=degen when routed.
Dana V: Console UX: add "Schema Diagnostics" widget showing top mismatched fields + scrubbed example + link to flip per-org grace.
Priya S: Finance: propose interim billing: if auto_coerce && no backend_tool_executed => bill at coerce_rate (30%). Will confirm.
Oleg M: I'll open PR for coercion logic and trace tags. Dana will draft Console ticket. Monitor for 2h then revert if stable. :white_check_mark:
